fields.v: Agentic SDLC Control Plane (policy and telemetry layer that allocates autonomy under cost, reliability and human-attention budgets), with Production-Qualified Change (PQC), Verification Tax, Total Cost to Deliver and Agentic Autonomy Budget. Version: Not stated (proposed, not implemented or evaluated). No SDD approach

Not SDD artefacts. Control plane records: risk class per task, execution plan (model, context strategy, harness, tool permissions, parallelism, hard budget), evidence bound to each risk class (tests, static analysis, reviewers, security scans, deployment gates), cost attribution records, machine-readable evidence bundles; versioned harnesses, prompts/policy and replayable trajectories

Work intake -> policy/risk classifier -> execution planner -> implementation agent with optional test/verifier, review and security agents -> CI/build/tests -> security/policy gates and human escalation/approval -> deploy/canary/rollback (production qualification) -> observability -> outcome learning (PQC, escaped defects, cost, SLOs). Reliability gate ladder: requirement fit, build/type checks, unit/property tests, integration/contract tests, security/dependency policy, review/ownership, deploy/canary, production SLO/rollback, maintenance/regression

Risk-adaptive review: human escalation/approval gate in the control plane, human approval for high-risk changes, expert attention reserved for architecture, security, ambiguous requirements and high-blast-radius changes; human merge authority in current practice (H0)

Not an exhaustive systematic review; some 2026 sources are preprints or organisation reports; company-reported outcomes may be biased; forecasts are planning signals; cited results come from different populations and cannot be compared directly; constructs (PQC, Verification Tax, Autonomy Budget, Control Plane) are unvalidated hypotheses. Research agenda RQ1-RQ10: predictors of PQC, adaptive verification budgets, correlated verifier errors, stop rules for long-horizon agents, cost attribution to value, real defect detection by AI tests, organisation design, agent coordination, reliability evidence across model/harness changes, senior engineer skills
